en.description:
A tiny pet lives on your wrist.

Pippet is a virtual pet made for Apple Watch — not a phone game squeezed onto a
small screen. Glance at your wrist and your pet is there, doing its own thing.

STROKE IT WITH THE DIGITAL CROWN
Turn the crown slowly and feel every gentle tick in your wrist — like a purr you
can actually feel. Spin fast and it giggles.

YOUR STEPS ARE ITS FOOD
Pippet feeds on your real activity. A good walk keeps your pet full and happy.
Or lift a treat to its mouth with the crown and watch it chomp.

ALWAYS IN VIEW
Put your pet on your watch face. It changes expression through the day all on
its own — hungry at noon, curled up asleep at night.

IT GROWS WITH YOU
Hatch a mystery egg, name your pet, and watch it grow through four life stages.
Three species to discover, each with its own little plant crown.

KIND BY DESIGN
Your pet never dies. Neglect it and it just naps until you come back — one touch
wakes it up. No guilt, no punishment. No subscription, no ads, no paid revivals.
When you're ready for a new friend, your old one rests safely in your codex.
en.releaseNotes:
Sorry about the rough start — the first release could crash the moment your
egg hatched. That's fixed, so your pet can finally hatch and settle in on
your wrist.

• Fixed a crash when the pet appeared on screen
• Improved layout on smaller Apple Watch models
